script: Time runs at different speeds depending on gravity and motion. Clocks on GPS satellites run fast by about 38 microseconds a day. That sounds tiny, but it really adds up. Without correcting for it, GPS positions would drift by kilometers every day. Einstein's theory of relativity is working inside your phone's map.
